mechanism.classification: Mixture of a premature unread citation, incomplete premise selection, and strict model judgment of a negative inference. Existing revision limit makes these errors terminal.
mechanism.retrieval_availability: Initial search surfaces the Ops page (section4), and the read agent introduction links the Ops/Calls tracing guide. The needed documentation is in the same snapshot, but the planner follows only the agent side before final submission. This is not demonstrated to be corpus absence or a retrieval-backend defect.
mechanism.not_syntax: All four case02 candidates contain zero Python fences; no syntax rejection is recorded anywhere in the 15-turn run.
mechanism.bounds_followed: 7 planner calls, 2 normal model audits plus one terminal recovery audit; 2 searches and 5 reads. Research capacity is not exhausted, but all three permitted submissions are rejected.

finding.judge_qualification: The judge is right that the final answer is incomplete. Its claim that the Partial label is misleading because the docs contain the answer is not persuasive: partial describes the delivered answer, and the runtime correctly exposes the missing outcome. Do not remove the label or count source-verifier success as task success.

recommendation.immediate: Preserve this failed first attempt. No reproducible deterministic runtime regression justifies another release patch on this evidence. Do not loosen citation/scope checks, extend the retry budget, or reinterpret the rubric to force a pass.
recommendation.smallest_future_bet: Use the existing research step to establish both sides of a requested contrast before the first draft, especially before asserting that one mechanism does not provide another. Test this on several frozen contrast questions and compare missing-premise reads, first-pass completion, cost and latency. A prompt change alone would be an unproven proposal, not an established fix.
recommendation.inference_calibration: The third draft may have been salvageable by explicitly labelling its conclusion as a synthesis, as the terminal auditor itself notes. That inconsistency motivates calibration tests, not bypassing an explicit rejecting verdict.
recommendation.causal_limit: One trial per case, changed runtime/effort and different judge outputs cannot isolate a causal regression. The prior 12/13,47/48 run failed a different case; the current 12/13,46/48 run is a retained new measurement, not proof of improvement.

preset_addendum.concrete_over_rejection: On full-draft attempt3, the auditor marks Signals score agent turns in production [S1] as partial while scope_status is supported and its reason explicitly says S1 supports the claim. It also requires an explicit evaluation-to-trace link despite a useful role comparison and an explicitly labelled suggested workflow.
preset_addendum.qualification: Earlier drafts contain actual loose scope/attribution, so this does not justify overriding all rejected verdicts or accepting unsupported factual claims.
preset_addendum.shared_next_check: Run the separately frozen four-candidate paired auditor probe before selecting any remedy. A stronger primary auditor might avoid repeated rewrites; a strict terminal full-draft second opinion could reuse the existing one judge call but preserves earlier latency and may reduce partial-answer availability.
